title: MobSimLab transport mode contributed by a plugin
description: One entry of a plugin's `modes` contribution point (ADR-0036 §3). Producer: plugin authors. Consumer: tools/plugins/check.py, the web app's mode and tool registry, the published timetable (`mode`, GTFS route_type).

id.description: Mode id, unique across the core and all plugins.

kit.description: Core authoring kit that draws the mode.

operation.description: frequency: a belt of vehicles with no timetable; shuttle: vehicles reverse between two ends; timetabled: exact trips.

contextKey.description: Assumption context key whose option picks the system or vessel type.

contexts.description: Options of contextKey this mode uses.
